digest.component_or_area: live external LLM provider matrix gate
propositions: The resolver canonicalizes openai model specs to 'openai-chat:' qualifier but the live external tier's credential map and guard assertions use literal 'openai:' prefix comparisons, causing AssertionError at test_provider_matrix_live.py:88.
Live external tests skip silently because _live_llm.py's _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV has no 'openai-chat' entry, so live_llm_ready() returns False even though the arm is configured for openai-family providers.

The unit-tier matrix gate (_MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER) was updated to map openai-chat qualifier to openai provider family by commit 8f4c5fdb0d3, but the live external tier's consumers were not updated to use the same family/qualifier distinction.

The fix adds _PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER map to _live_llm.py and a provider_family() helper so configured_provider() returns the provider family name, making credential lookup and guard comparisons consistent with REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER.

Guard tests must compare resolved spec qualifiers by their provider family rather than literal prefix, preserving the guard's ability to detect mismatched provider families while eliminating the false positive on openai-chat specs.
